request: Wire the Stitch (Google Labs AI UI design tool) MCP server into Claude Code; document the Stitch -> ui/ kit translation convention; apply it to build one screen (Login + Menu navigation) the user designed in Stitch, mirroring the charges gold-standard slice.

decisions.decision: The Stitch screen to translate is the Login screen plus the Menu navigation (redesign-or-new TBD by the design at grill time; data + read paths pinned then).
MCP scope is the committed project .mcp.json (shared; token via ${STITCH_API_TOKEN} env expansion), NOT user-level ~/.claude/mcp_servers.json.

The grill-me pass (required by openspec/config.yaml) runs AFTER the Stitch MCP is connected (Claude Code restart + confirm Stitch tools), so the Login+Menu data model and read paths are grilled against the actual design.

DESIGN.md -> custom DaisyUI theme mapping is DEFERRED (not part of this change). Will be recorded in openspec/roadmaps/backlog.md when wanted; this change only translates one Stitch screen into a ui/-kit slice.

SUPersedes D2: the Stitch MCP connection is GLOBAL (user's global opencode/Claude Code MCP config, available to any project), NOT project-scoped. Rationale: Stitch is a general design tool, not this project's infrastructure. This repo keeps only the translation-convention doc (ai/htmx-conventions.md) and no Stitch config or secret. Also corrects the transport: Stitch is a REMOTE server at https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp with an X-Goog-Api-Key header (env-indirected via {env:STITCH_API_KEY}), not the @google/stitch-mcp stdio wrapper D2 assumed.
